migrationNotes: Runtime case identity: first_garden, The First Garden, Restored Terrace, Earth.

Case 06 is the Campaign 2 bonus finale. The runtime hides it from level select until the five main cases are complete and then numbers it case 6 of 6, applying no bonus, epilogue, or special-investigation wording, so the package registers positionally as 6 - The First Garden, following the Campaign 1 precedent for its two bonus cases.

Seven tasks over five Student pages. The case reports no time series, no dated events and no calculation, so the packet carries no timeline, no trend figure and no precision task; its reasoning is scope, elimination and convergence rather than measurement.

One figure. Figure A is a plan view of circular patches where the surveyed compounds are abundant inside ground where the same compounds fall to trace levels, because circular patches of approximately four to six metres in diameter is what the survey reports. It states in both caption and extended description that it shows the reported pattern rather than mapping the garden.

The Student CER shares its page with Task 7 under data-student-cer-page=combined-v1.0, the form Campaign 1 Case 07 established. On a page of its own the CER left roughly half the page empty. The Accessible CER remains a dedicated canonical page.

The packet follows the shipped runtime and the approved science-source register over the design document, which frames the mechanism as the wood wide web and states as fact that the connections were never fully restored. The mycorrhizal explanation stays a candidate cause, compatible partners are never declared certainly absent, trace levels are never restated as zero, and no printable role proposes moving living material without identification, provenance and pathogen screening, host-compatibility checks, approval, untreated controls and monitoring.

Task 7 specifies the trial and stops there. The runtime reform-recommendation thread turns on Concord politics rather than the garden evidence and is carried as Teacher-facing discussion rather than a written student prompt.
Case 06 was authored directly as canonical package sources and released after on-screen review and owner-confirmed physical print review; no migration from generated release documents occurred.
